description: Redesign all app development page components to match the professional design quality of the homepage, replacing generic placeholders with rich, interactive components using the established GlowCard/Tilt pattern, custom SVG icons, and orange-amber gradient CTAs with indigo-purple accent colors
steps: Redesign AppDevHeroSection.tsx to use the GlowCard + Tilt pattern from ServicesHeroSection.tsx, replace the basic gradient background with the established gray-50/dark-950 pattern, add custom mobile development visual animation (phone mockup with app screens or device showcase), implement proper metrics (80+ apps delivered, 4.8★ avg rating, iOS+Android support), use orange-amber gradient CTA buttons with indigo-purple accents

Redesign AppDevServicesSection.tsx following ServicesCategoriesSection.tsx layout with 3-4 service cards (Native iOS Apps, Native Android Apps, Cross-Platform Apps, App Maintenance & Updates) using GlowCard components with custom SVG icons for mobile platforms

Redesign AppDevTechnologiesSection.tsx as a marquee carousel similar to ServicesIndustriesSection.tsx but for mobile technologies (iOS Swift, Android Kotlin, React Native, Flutter, Firebase, Node.js API, MongoDB, Push Notifications) with custom SVG icons for each technology

Redesign AppDevProcessSection.tsx using the features grid pattern from ServicesFeaturesSection.tsx showing development phases (Strategy & Research, UI/UX Design, Development & Integration, Testing & QA, Store Deployment, Post-Launch Support) with mobile-specific considerations and app store focus

Redesign AppDevPortfolioSection.tsx with 3-4 mobile app project cards using the Tilt + GlowCard pattern, featuring mobile app screenshots/mockups and descriptions that align with mobile development focus, including app store badges and ratings
acceptance_criteria: All AppDev components use the established GlowCard and Tilt patterns from the design system
Custom SVG icons are used throughout, specifically mobile-focused icons
Orange-amber gradient CTAs with indigo-purple accents are consistently applied
All components have proper dark mode support
Framer Motion animations follow the established entrance and hover patterns
Mobile-specific visual elements (phone mockups, app store badges) are properly integrated
verification: npm run build successfully compiles all AppDev components
Visual inspection shows professional design matching homepage quality with mobile app focus
All interactive elements (hover states, animations) work correctly
Color scheme properly uses orange-amber CTAs with indigo-purple accents
